title: Save Your Soul
description: Save Your Soul is a simple mod that adds the ability to save your progress, much like in Undertale.
body:
**"Save Your Soul"** is a simple mod that adds the ability to save your progress, much like in Undertale.

# **! WARNING !**

This is my first ever modding project, so bugs may appear. If you encounter any, please report them — I'd really appreciate it.

Also, keep in mind that this mod is inherently somewhat "cheaty," since it allows you to save and load at any moment. Consider that before installing.


# **How it works**

While playing, you can open the save menu at any time by pressing the **default key: G**.

Clicking the **"Save"** button sets your respawn point to your current location.

Clicking the **"Load"** button teleports you back to that saved point.

# **Leveling System**

The mod also includes a leveling mechanic. By killing creatures, you gain experience, which allows you to increase your level. Your current level is displayed in the save menu.

You can open your stats menu at any time by pressing **H** (default).

Each time you level up, you gain **+1 HP, +0.5 movement speed, and +0.5 dodge chance**.

The maximum level is **20**.

# **Configuration**

You can fully customize the system to your liking in the config file **sys_config**. There you can adjust the maximum level, bonuses per level, required and earned experience amounts, or even disable the system entirely.

# **Commands**

**/give_points [player] [number]** — gives the specified player a set amount of experience.

**/set_lvl [player] [number]** — sets the specified player to a given level.

**/get_stats [player]** — displays the selected player's stats, including level, current experience, experience needed for the next level, and current bonuses.
